continuity_instruction: Preserve every person exactly throughout the scene. Keep the same face, identity, age, body appearance, skin tone, clothing, clothing colors, accessories and hairstyle. Keep the same number of people. Do not add or remove people. Preserve the same location, background, objects, time of day, lighting and weather. Do not add, remove or replace anything unless the user explicitly requests it. Only perform the requested movement or action. Everything else must remain visually consistent and unchanged.
continuity_negative_instruction: identity change, face change, different person, age change, clothing change, color change, hairstyle change, skin tone change, new person, missing person, extra person, new object, missing object, background change, location change, lighting change, weather change, time change, random additions, random removals, scene inconsistency
